description: This Java class defines the configuration model for LwM2M (Lightweight Machine to Machine) transport in the Thingsboard server, including attributes, observation strategies, and merge logic.

classes.name: LwM2MModelConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for LwM2M model including attributes, observation strategies, and merge functionality.

methods.name: LwM2MModelConfig
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields with provided parameters.

methods.name: LwM2MModelConfig

methods.description: Merges another LwM2MModelConfig into this one, updating attributes and observation sets accordingly.
